Top right Tung Tung Tung Sahur: recognizable tall rounded wooden cylindrical log body with human-like broad eyes, eyebrows, nose and mouth carved into wood, long thin wooden arms and legs, bare wood feet, simple wooden baseball bat, NOT a box robot or armored knight. Bottom left Cappuccino Assassino: white coffee cup with coffee top, black ninja headband and face covering, short black limbs, two katana swords.
